products.short_description: A messaging-specific support-operations runbook — L2–L4 roles + escalation, ITIL incident & problem management for mail, on-call, SLA/FCR/CSAT practices, and KB/coaching — so the team delivers to SLA with a positive customer experience. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run L2–L4 Microsoft 365 messaging support to SLA with ITIL discipline

A messaging support team lives or dies by consistent operations — SLAs met, escalations clean, root causes fixed, and knowledge captured. This solution is the messaging-specific support-operations runbook: L2/L3/L4 responsibilities and escalation, ITIL incident and problem management for mail issues, on-call, service-availability handling, First-Call-Resolution/CSAT and reopen-reduction practices, and knowledge-base + coaching workflows — so the team delivers to SLA with a positive customer experience. (Scoped to messaging support ops — distinct from a general desktop-support runbook or security incident response.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the messaging support operating model: L2–L4 roles + escalation, ITIL incident/problem management for mail, on-call, SLA/FCR/CSAT, and KB/coaching.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (a ticketing/ITSM tool + SLAs, messaging admin access for the team, on-call rota, KB platform).
  • Implementation Guide — define L2–L4 responsibilities + escalation paths, stand up incident and problem management for messaging, wire on-call + service-availability handling, set the FCR/CSAT/reopen practices, and operate KB + coaching — each runbook named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Runbook Library + validation gates (SLAs tracked, problems closed with root cause, KB current) plus Best Practices for a high-CSAT messaging support practice.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A messaging support team that delivers to SLA with high CSAT — L2–L4 escalation clean, incidents and problems managed to root cause, knowledge captured — consistent operations, not firefighting.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Find-RecurringMessagingIncidents.ps1 — Recurring-incident / problem-candidate analyzer (read-only). From an exported ticket CSV, clusters
    • Get-MessagingSlaMetricsReport.ps1 — SLA / ticket-metric rollup report (read-only). From an exported ticket CSV, computes SLA attainment
    • Get-ServiceHealthTriage.ps1 — Service Health / message-trace triage helper (read-only). Lists active Exchange Online service
    • New-MessagingRunbookConfig.ps1 — KB / runbook config helper. Generates a starter ticket taxonomy (categories + P1-P4 priorities),
    • Test-MailboxMailFlowHealth.ps1 — Mailbox / mail-flow health-check for common tickets (read-only). Returns the key facts L2 needs to

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
